(rule!
  (let* ((key (at g 0 0))
         (obj (crop-to-content (set-cell g 0 0 0))))
    (if (= key 1)
        (rotate-cw obj)
        (if (= key 2) (rotate-180 obj) (rotate-ccw obj)))))

(rule!
  (let* ((key (at g 0 0))
         (obj (crop-to-content (set-cell g 0 0 0))))
    (if (= key 1)
        (rotate-cw obj)
        (if (= key 2) (rotate-180 obj) (rotate-ccw obj)))))

(rule!
  (let* ((key (at g 0 0))
         (obj (crop-to-content (set-cell g 0 0 0)))
         (rotated (if (= key 1) (rotate-cw obj) (if (= key 2) (rotate-180 obj) (rotate-ccw obj)))))
    (let* ((shape rotated)
             (color (first (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (apply append shape))))
             (counts (map (lambda (r) (length (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (row shape r)))) (range (rows shape))))
             (extreme (apply max (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0)) counts)))
             (candidates (filter (lambda (r) (= (list-ref counts r) extreme)) (range (rows shape))))
             (targets (list (first candidates))))
        (for/fold ((out shape)) ((r targets))
          (for/fold ((out out)) ((c (range (cols shape))))
            (set-cell out r c color))))))
